summary: Talk-only turn after the owner's deploy to jeelive.ai. No application file was changed. One test-only suite was added and run: website and app are one account, both ways.
run_by: the main agent (builder), NOT the testing agent
what_it_is: The real website server code against a disposable database (made and dropped by the suite itself; storage mocked; no AI; no network). 'The app' is an httpx client with no Origin, no Sec-Fetch header and its own cookie jar per phone, as app book v3 Part 6 describes the app's server.
what_it_is_not: a run by the testing agent
proven: sign-up on either side signs in on the other with the same id
a second sign-up with a number that has an account is refused (409); the number typed four ways is one account
a display name saved on one side is read on the other
one attempt across both sides: start twice = the same attempt, answers both ways, one result, My Tests, Misfire ids <attempt id>:<question id>, try and done
PIN change and Forgot PIN keep the id and end the other sessions; refresh; sign-out per device
a write with a foreign Origin is refused (403 origin_denied); no Origin is let in
wrong PINs for a number are counted together from both sides; a right PIN clears the count
as_built_and_worth_knowing: Per address (the hop left of Cloudflare in X-Forwarded-For): 60 sign-ups + PIN changes + Forgot PINs together per clock quarter hour; 100 wrong PINs within 15 minutes make that address wait 15 minutes, right PINs too. With every app request arriving from one address the 61st sign-up got 429 and, after 100 wrong PINs, a right PIN got 429. Whether the app's production server reaches the website from one address is NOT known.
App book v3 Part 6.2 says the website has no public Forgot PIN and the app uses the owner's reset. POST /api/auth/pin/reset exists since 15 Nov 2026 and answers on live.

post_run_safety_check.note: The two isolated databases were there before this run and were not touched. No suite is running.

there: 405 on GET for auth/phone, auth/phone/signup, auth/pin, auth/pin/reset, auth/refresh, auth/logout, profile/display-name
